why: Both analyses match the key's hedgehog, refuse Halvard Six and the student brand, and cover all three key brutal facts, though Analysis 1 makes the 2% core-market ceiling its most urgent fact, closer to the key. Analysis 2 shows more restraint for an already-great subject: it frames the job as stewardship, keeps recommendations fewer, and focuses on codifying the Listening Room veto and testing the successor, where Analysis 1 adds new-region expansion and a bounded guitar test.
